STS2_WAYFINDER_MOD-ENABLE_WAYFINDER.hove: Combine and reshuffle each act's points into a single unified path. Takes effect when you start a new run. A run in progress stays as it is.
STS2_WAYFINDER_MOD-PRESET.title: Difficulty preset
STS2_WAYFINDER_MOD-PRESET.hover.title: Difficulty preset
STS2_WAYFINDER_MOD-PRESET.hover.desc: Sets every difficulty option below. Takes effect when you start a new run. A run in progress keeps the options it started with. Off keeps vanilla numbers. Bosses only scales bosses and changes nothing else. Power curve lowers rewards and raises enemy strength through Acts 2 and 3. Custom: options no longer match a preset. Pick a preset to reset them.
STS2_WAYFINDER_MOD-ENEMY_SCALING.title: Enemy scaling
STS2_WAYFINDER_MOD-SCALE_BOSSES.title: Scale bosses
STS2_WAYFINDER_MOD-SCALE_BOSSES.hover.de: Bosses get more HP and damage: Act 2 bosses +30% HP and +15% damage, Act 3 bosses +50% HP and +25% damage. Act 1 bosses stay vanilla.
STS2_WAYFINDER_MOD-SCALE_PATH_HP.title: Scale fight HP along the path
STS2_WAYFINDER_MOD-SCALE_PATH_HP.hover.t: Scale fight HP along the path
STS2_WAYFINDER_MOD-SCALE_PATH_HP.hover.d: Monster, Elite, and Unknown fights get more HP the further along Acts 2 and 3 they sit, from vanilla at the start of Act 2 to +80% at its end and +190% at the end of Act 3.
STS2_WAYFINDER_MOD-SCALE_PATH_DAMAGE.tit: Scale fight damage along the path
STS2_WAYFINDER_MOD-SCALE_PATH_DAMAGE.hov: Scale fight damage along the path

Monster, Elite, and Unknown fights hit harder the further along Acts 2 and 3 they sit, from vanilla at the start of Act 2 to +50% at its end and +160% at the end of Act 3. The enemy's intent shows the scaled damage.
STS2_WAYFINDER_MOD-CARD_REWARDS.title: Card rewards
STS2_WAYFINDER_MOD-ALTERNATE_CARD_REWARD: Normal combats, including combats from Unknowns, alternate between a card reward and none, starting each act with a reward. Elites and bosses always give one.
STS2_WAYFINDER_MOD-CARD_CHOICES.title: Card choices
STS2_WAYFINDER_MOD-CARD_CHOICES.hover.de: How many cards a combat's card reward offers. Vanilla offers 3. Card rewards from relics and events keep their own count.
STS2_WAYFINDER_MOD-TREASURE_CHESTS.title: Treasure chests
STS2_WAYFINDER_MOD-USE_CHEST_CHANCES.hov: Each chest is either a relic chest or a gold chest with no relic. The act's last chest is always a relic chest.
STS2_WAYFINDER_MOD-CHEST_ODDS.title: Chest odds
STS2_WAYFINDER_MOD-CHEST_ODDS.hover.desc: How often a chest holds a relic. Generous: 25% to start, +25% for each gold chest in a row, gold chests give 2x gold. Balanced: 20%, +20%, 2x gold. Stingy: 15%, +15%, 1.5x gold. A relic chest resets the chance.
STS2_WAYFINDER_MOD-ELITE_RELICS.title: Elite relics
STS2_WAYFINDER_MOD-LOWER_ELITE_RELIC_RAR: An Elite's relic shifts toward Common. Elites still always drop a relic.
STS2_WAYFINDER_MOD-GOLD.title: Gold
STS2_WAYFINDER_MOD-GOLD_RATE.title: Gold rate
STS2_WAYFINDER_MOD-GOLD_RATE.hover.title: Gold rate
STS2_WAYFINDER_MOD-GOLD_RATE.hover.desc: How much gold you earn compared with vanilla. Lean is 75%, Vanilla is 100%, Rich is 125%.
